solar_power_management.name: solar_power_management
solar_power_management.description: Manage device power and shutdown procedures on a power limited device, e.g. in a solar context.

solar_power_dashboard.name: solar_power_dashboard
solar_power_dashboard.description: Fleet dashboard for devices running Solar Power Management - online / offline / nearly-offline status, power-management fault alerts, and projected time-to-offline from each device's battery-voltage trajectory.
solar_power_dashboard.build_widget_command: npm --prefix dashboard-widget install && npm --prefix dashboard-widget run build
